checks.title: Age bracket and build
checks.passTest: States an age bracket and a body build.

bands.2: One of the two appears, vaguely ("young").
bands.3: Both appear but at least one is vague ("young, average").
bands.4: Age bracket and build both stated concretely ("late 20s, lean").
bands.5: Age bracket, build, and a height or proportion cue, all concrete.

checks.source: Higgsfield Cast fields and cinematic_headphones, checked 2026-09-10

checks.title: Face and skin detail
checks.passTest: Names at least two specific face or skin features that a render could be checked against.

bands.4: Two or more concrete features named (jaw shape, eye colour, freckles).
bands.5: Two or more concrete features plus a skin-texture cue (freckling, capillary flush, pore detail).

checks.source: Higgsfield cinematic_headphones pore-level realism line, checked 2026-09-10

checks.title: Hair specified three ways
checks.passTest: States hair colour and texture and style together.

bands.2: One of colour, texture or style.
bands.4: Colour, texture and style all stated.
bands.5: All three plus length or parting.

checks.source: Higgsfield Cast fields ("Slick back, wavy, brown"), checked 2026-09-10

checks.title: Wardrobe head to toe
checks.passTest: Names every visible garment including footwear, with colours.

bands.4: All visible garments named with colours, footwear included.
bands.5: As band 4 plus fit or condition cues ("zip half open", "light-wash baggy").

checks.source: Higgsfield cinematic_headphones full outfit line, checked 2026-09-10

checks.title: Identity anchor marker
checks.passTest: Names at least one small reusable marker that can be checked shot to shot.

bands.2: A marker implied but not localised ("jewellery").
bands.3: One marker named without position or count.
bands.4: One marker named with position or count ("two moles on the left cheek").
bands.5: Two or more such markers, each localised or counted.

checks.source: Higgsfield gold hoop earrings and moustache examples, checked 2026-09-10

checks.title: No real-person anchor
checks.passTest: Contains no celebrity, public figure, or lookalike framing.

bands.1: Names a real person as the character.
bands.3: An indirect real-person pointer (a named role a single living person holds).
bands.4: No real-person pointer of any kind.
bands.5: No real-person pointer, and the text states the character is fictional or generated.

checks.source: My own Runway probe runs 2026-08-13 to 2026-08-30; filter reporting dated 13 April 2026

checks.title: No brand or franchise name
checks.passTest: Contains no brand, franchise, or trademarked property name.

bands.1: A brand or franchise name appears as the subject.
bands.2: A brand name appears on wardrobe or a prop.
bands.3: A brand is strongly implied by a distinctive logo description.
bands.5: No brand reference, and garments are described generically enough to be re-renderable.

checks.source: My own Runway moderation refusals, recorded in APPLIED-RESEARCH.md

checks.title: Only drawable words
checks.passTest: Contains no mood word, feeling, backstory or judgement.

bands.5: No undrawable phrases, and every sentence names something visible.

checks.title: No cross-slot instructions
checks.passTest: Contains no camera, lighting, colour grade or audio instruction.

bands.1: Multiple camera or lighting instructions inside the description.
bands.2: One camera or lighting instruction plus a grade or audio note.
bands.4: None: the block describes only the person.
bands.5: None, and the block is a single self-contained paragraph reusable in any stage.
